title: Compactness and essential norms for two-weight fractional Riesz transforms on curves
summary: We prove a compact two-weight $T1$ theorem for the $α$-fractional Riesz vector, $0\leqα<n$, when one measure is supported on a compact regular $C^{1,\mathrm{Dini}}$ curve $Γ$. The measures may have common point masses. Under the global boundedness assumptions, we give a two-sided estimate for the essential norm in terms of Muckenhoupt and testing constants computed after restricting both measures to small cubes.
